name: nabladown.js
author: Pedroth
description: A lightweight JavaScript library for parsing a pseudo-Markdown language into HTML. Designed for rendering math, code, and HTML with ease. Extend the syntax using macros and control the output with custom HTML renderers.

scripts.pub: npm version patch; bun run build; npm publish;  git push origin $(git describe --tags `git rev-list --tags --max-count=1`)
